subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Why EVs Skip the Gearbox
description: A quick win: understand Why EVs Skip the Gearbox.

hook.text: Electric cars usually have just one gear. No shifting, no clutch, no torque converter.

buildup.text: A gas engine makes power in a narrow RPM band and needs gears to stretch it across speeds.

discovery.text: Electric motors deliver full torque from zero RPM and stay efficient across a wide speed range.

twist.text: That's why EVs feel so fast off the line—instant torque with no gear changes to interrupt.

climax.text: Some performance EVs like the Porsche Taycan use two gears for even more top speed efficiency.

punchline.text: Electric motors are so flexible they barely need gears.

quiz.question: Why do most EVs have only one gear?
options: Electric motors deliver torque across all speeds
